body:
Scope: distinct fresh independent final whole-change Code Review after M1, M2 and M3 closed with their required corrections. Exact complete engineering range e861676350c7a8fdc8b3b8ea69c8d4068cefd3a7..2db663f6751c9b766107475073d32299a0d4fa7c. All 49 surviving changed engineering subjects are recorded structurally; all 13 deleted subjects and their baseline identities/current absence remain enumerated in the inspected M3 review. Earlier milestone reviews inform but do not substitute for this complete-scope assessment. Independently confirmed all 49 current file bytes equal the committed engineering head, and the deletion count/path set remains exact.

Integrated ownership and M1: approved proposal, diagnostic-clarified Test/Workflow Design and amended Delivery remain the basis, subject to the subsequent direct user scope override. Shared Test criteria supply useful-test and maintenance reasoning; actual specialist judgments, applicability and closeout stay under Review and Closeout. Eleven quality and eight maintenance resource copies match their portable sources and their conditional entrypoints. Public resources contain project-facing guidance rather than private requirement IDs. The canonical validator checks missing/drift/unknown consumers mechanically, without becoming a semantic approval gate. Current candidate metadata reflects resource changes while historical metadata, runtime commands, schemas and storage authority remain unchanged.

M2 coherence: the complete-mirror test uses independent rglob relative-path/byte dictionaries instead of trusting only the builder collector. The removed proposal-only method exercises the same command with a subset oracle and provides no lost distinct detection/diagnostic boundary. All ten ModelRecordTests and their partitions remain. Existing public/helper, default/explicit-root, missing/stale, unknown-value and historical input distinctions remain where required. This is ordinary protection-preserving consolidation under the published criteria, with complete-module post-change proof. Its claim is bounded to the original eighteen-method audit, not later deletions.

M3 exception and actual loss: the later direct user request outranks the ordinary preservation condition solely for the thirteen named historical lifecycle/final-verification files and eleven cache applicability methods. Their removed tests protect still-supported behavior. Neither the model nor its prior approval declares them redundant, retires compatibility, or supplies replacement detection. No broader unanswered cache clarification authorizes further removal. Fourteen retained cache methods have identical ASTs; only the newly unused final-verification import is removed outside selected definitions. Runtime, fixtures, helpers and unlisted tests remain unchanged. Removed coverage includes ownership, settlement/routing, transactions/rollback, migration/repair, unknown/freshness limits, eligibility/unsafe lookup, dependency failures, locality, reuse/invalidation and cache-only final-proof restrictions. This is reduced regression protection, not an improvement in confidence.

Cross-milestone TG-FINAL-01: useful diagnostic contribution, independent outcome oracles, public versus helper boundaries, legacy/missing-authority preservation, randomized reproduction context and flaky-test handling remain coherent across Design, shared guidance and specialist entrypoints. M2 demonstrates normal criteria application. M3 deliberately departs from the ordinary no-lost-protection removal condition under the explicit higher-priority instruction; the amended plan and actual evidence disclose that difference. No policy consumer was weakened to normalize this exception, no runtime obligation was silently retired, and no remaining green suite is treated as proof of the deleted obligations. Historical documentation of removed test commands remains historical evidence, not current executable validation.

Checklist assessment: requirement alignment holds within the explicitly amended authority; test adequacy for remaining behavior is supported within actual claimed scope, with M3 protection loss disclosed; edge/error/compatibility runtime unchanged but their selected regression protection reduced; architecture and assessment ownership coherent; security/privacy implementation and permissions unchanged; generated surfaces current on unchanged M1 inputs; unrelated-change exclusion confirmed; direct proof and discovery accounting adequate for the bounded request. No material implementation finding or unresolved necessary decision emerged. The intentional coverage loss remains a substantive limitation rather than an unrecorded defect or a claim of ordinary policy compliance.

Proof: reviewed current M1 semantic scenarios, canonical 20, skill 373, all three adapters/full adapter 158, and package metadata evidence on unchanged sources. M2 proof includes strengthened assertion before consolidation, fault-detection probes with their stated limits, and full modules 7/87 after changes. M3 fresh npm package execution reports 488 passed versus prior 654 total, exactly the 166 deleted runtime cases (including two prior skips); disappearance of those skips is not a fix. Cache execution reports 14 passed versus baseline 25, with eleven exact removals and unchanged retained ASTs. Full-range whitespace check passes. Unchanged evidence reuse is based on relevant subject and environment scope; older npm/cache or final results are not relabeled as current runs.

Current final-ci evidence and completed log were independently inspected: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base e861676350c7a8fdc8b3b8ea69c8d4068cefd3a7 --head 2db663f6751c9b766107475073d32299a0d4fa7c --jobs 4 --timeout 900 passed all 18 selected checks, including fresh validation_cache.regression, the exact-revision lifecycle validation, Node package and publication checks. This is actual expanded full-branch local command proof, not hosted CI or a Verify result. Final review recording changes only this assessment and applicability. Earlier final assessment subjects are not evidence for the expanded scope. Verify must now independently assess current evidence, concerns, exact applicability and the disclosed coverage exception before producing its success-only explanation. This review does not itself route or authorize external publication.
independence_basis: A separate delegated nonauthor agent /root/independent_proposal_review executed this fresh final assessment after all three implementation milestones closed. codex-author authored all engineering changes and audit evidence; this reviewer authored only independent review records. The same independent reviewer earlier assessed milestones, but this execution freshly examined the complete committed change, public criteria-to-maintenance interaction, exact authority and final full-range proof; no milestone judgment was relabeled as final approval.
